implementation.behavior: Accept aggregate BLOCKED only when the selected asset is PRESENT_VALID and non-eligible, the explicitly expected remaining assets are MISSING background assets with REGISTERED_ASSET_BLOB_MISSING and restoreEligible, all other registered assets are PRESENT_VALID and non-eligible, pending artifacts are valid, broken references are absent, and no-write/no-Foundry state is true. Accept PASS only when no expected remaining asset exists.

decision.reason: M590 closes only the local predicate correction. A fresh additive fixture/session identity, artifact, and packaged observation are still required before the asset-restore producer can be accepted, and Stage 11 remains an every-producer aggregate gate.

selectedNextBoundary.title: Stage 11 asset-restore fresh v3 fixture and session identity
